title: Morpho fixture envelope
description: Versioned wrapper for deterministic offline test fixtures shared by Rust, Python, and TypeScript tests. This is test infrastructure: it never defines domain fields and always defers payload validation to the canonical schemas in packages/schemas.

fixture_envelope_version.description: Envelope format version. Bump only for breaking envelope changes, never for payload schema updates.

fixture_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the repository. Must equal the directory name that holds fixture.json.

kind.description: What the input payload is. Must equal the input schema $id last path segment with the .json extension and .vN version suffix removed, e.g. research-config for research-config.v1.json.

schema.description: Canonical schema $id from packages/schemas. Never an inline second copy of a schema.

expected_outputs.description: Golden results compared against pipeline behavior. Entries are added only after the corresponding output schema is frozen in packages/schemas.

synthetic.description: True means the fixture contains no captured provider output, no personal data, and no private research content.

deterministic.description: False means the fixture contains volatile fields (timestamps, generated IDs) that comparisons must normalize before asserting.

ignored_fields.description: Field paths excluded from golden comparisons, e.g. created_at.
